concerns.text: The plan’s Phase 4 describes a permutation test comparing Full vs Null models (FR‑002, SC‑002) but does not include the required FR‑012 – an independent permutation‑importance test for each engineered interaction column with BH‑corrected p‑values.

SC‑001 (baseline mean‑only model must be outperformed by ≥ 0.05 R² or ≥ 10 % RMSE improvement) is not referenced in any phase; the plan never specifies training or evaluating a baseline model for comparison.

FR‑006 (collinearity detection) is listed for Phase 5, which is an interpretability step; collinearity checks are more appropriate during data‑validation (Phase 0) and should be moved accordingly for logical coherence.
